title: Hierarchical Topic Modeling via Contrastive Learning and Hyperbolic Embedding
subcategory: GAN-based hierarchical topic model in hyperbolic space
problem: Euclidean hierarchical topic models lose tree-like semantics, and GAN topic models suffer mode collapse from latent discontinuity.
architecture: hHTM: encoder with MoCo-style contrastive learning on TF-IDF documents (masked-word augmentation), generator/decoder and discriminator (GAN); topic embeddings projected into hyperbolic space; multi-head self-attention learns parent-child topic structure under DAG constraints.
key_results: Best CLNPMI on all datasets (e.g. 20News 0.215 vs 0.164) and best TU (Wikitext-103 0.912 vs 0.797).
NPMI best only on Wikitext-103 (0.274); NSEM-GMHTM higher on NIPS (0.147) and 20News (0.307).
strengths: Combines hyperbolic geometry with contrastive learning for more reasonable parent-child topics.

limitations.text: Future work needs external prior knowledge to guide contrastive learning.
GAN training adds complexity; all models fixed at 200 topics.

notes: CluHTM did not converge within 48 hours on Wikitext-103.
